mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_role WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_role ( role_code, role_nm, description, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE roles SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
